iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear talks are still moving, but Mojtaba Khamenei rejecting external removal of enriched uranium keeps 60 percent stockpile and inspection-continuity risk active; no verified higher-level jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: US and Iran traded air strikes around Gulf/Hormuz targets while Qatar talks were convening; oil rose on Gulf-route risk. Talks cap the ceiling, but fresh strikes and retaliation make this the acute Middle East driver.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: BBC, France24, PBS, Guardian and Le Monde report evacuation orders, a southern Lebanon combat zone, Israeli strikes and Hezbollah fighting; Netanyahu signaled further escalation, so the post-truce channel is deteriorating.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Fresh Turkey scan found limited-role analysis and older missile-defense commentary, not an authoritative strategic warning, weapons demonstration, or NATO crisis trigger in the current window.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains tense: border demolition reporting and a claimed border air-defense alert lift vigilance slightly, while China-linked peace commentary and lack of verified force surge keep the tracker near deterrent/elevated boundary.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk stays high: European officials again warned Moscow may expand the war beyond Ukraine, and nuclear-use commentary remains active; however today did not add a confirmed direct NATO clash.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains elevated by the recent Pratas coast-guard standoff and baseline PLA pressure, but Reuters/MSN reporting says the Chinese ship withdrew and fresh 24h searches found no new blockade or direct clash.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea tested new lightweight launch systems, tactical cruise missiles and AI-guided systems under Kim supervision; no device-event evidence surfaced, but weapons testing keeps risk at the elevated/critical boundary.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains the highest raw tracker: NYT and Ukrainian/financial feeds report intensified Kyiv strike threats and attacks, Zelenskyy seeking air defenses, and wider-war warnings from Europe.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: NYT and regional feeds frame Pakistan-Afghanistan as an active border-fighting stalemate, while China-mediated Islamabad-Taliban engagement keeps deconfliction channels alive.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical from the continuing SAF-RSF drone/infrastructure-strike pattern and external-backing allegations, but today’s fresh RSS scan produced no new Port Sudan-scale trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza/Jerusalem risk remains critical: fresh items say Israel killed a new Hamas military leader and strikes continue while ceasefire/hostage-deal optimism remains unresolved.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated on carried UNISFA/Abyei warning conditions and unauthorized-force concerns; no fresh 24h escalation item surfaced.

latest_news.headline: US and Iran trade air strikes near Gulf/Hormuz
latest_news.text: NYT, DW, Korea Times, Malay Mail and Deccan Herald report US strikes, Iranian retaliation and Gulf/Hormuz tension while Qatar talks convene.

latest_news.headline: Israel opens southern Lebanon combat zone
latest_news.text: BBC, France24, PBS, Guardian and Le Monde report evacuation orders, strikes and Hezbollah fighting in southern Lebanon.

latest_news.headline: Russia intensifies Kyiv strike-threat cycle
latest_news.text: NYT, UA.NEWS and financial feeds report harder Russian strike threats, Kyiv attacks and Ukrainian requests for additional air defenses.

latest_news.headline: DPRK tests new launchers and AI-guided missiles
latest_news.text: USNI, NHK, ABC/MSN and AOL-linked reporting cite new lightweight launch systems, tactical cruise missiles and AI-guided missile testing.

latest_news.headline: European officials warn Russia may expand war
latest_news.text: Kyiv Post and WSJ-linked results carry European warnings that Moscow may expand the war beyond Ukraine; nuclear-use commentary remains in the information space.

latest_news.headline: Iran talks advance but uranium-removal red line hardens
latest_news.text: White House-linked reporting says talks advance, while Mojtaba Khamenei rejects external removal of enriched uranium, preserving breakout-risk concern.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan fighting framed as diplomatic stalemate
latest_news.text: NYT and regional feeds describe continuing Pakistan-Afghanistan fighting; China-mediated Islamabad-Taliban engagement remains active.

latest_news.headline: India-Pakistan tension stays below fresh escalation threshold
latest_news.text: Border demolition and an unconfirmed air-defense-alert claim raise vigilance, while peace-process commentary and no verified force surge keep risk contained.

latest_news.headline: Pratas standoff fades after Chinese ship withdraws
latest_news.text: Reuters/MSN/Indian Express reporting from May 24-25 says a Chinese ship withdrew after the Pratas standoff; no fresh blockade or direct clash surfaced in today's scan.

latest_news.headline: Turkey remains a limited-role spillover actor
latest_news.text: Washington Institute and Atlantic Council-style results frame Turkey as exposed to regional spillover, but no fresh NATO crisis trigger appeared today.
